Title: Generally Available: SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 22

Body.Content:
SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) has long been the trusted tool for managing SQL databases, writing T-SQL, and troubleshooting issues. With SSMS 22, built on Visual Studio 2026, you get support for SQL Server 2025, improved integration with SQL databases in Fabric, and native compatibility on Windows ARM64 devices. This release also introduces the GitHub Copilot preview, giving you AI-powered assistance for T-SQL authoring and optimization directly within SSMS. 

Learn more.
